# W.I.S.E.C.E.O. — Worldwide Institute For Success And Excellence

> W.I.S.E.C.E.O. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 41-3404888) headquartered in West Chester, Ohio, creating equity and opportunity through digital literacy, workforce development, literacy and language access, and economic mobility for underserved communities. Led by educators with 30+ years in public education, it has reached more than 25,000 students, with chapters in Kentucky, Florida and Mississippi and impact across 35 nations.

W.I.S.E.C.E.O. serves refugees and immigrants (including newcomer families and English learners), underserved students of high school age and older, underserved women and girls, veterans, and first-generation and low-income youth and adults. Founder: Tiffany Davidson, M.Ed. LSLS, M.Ed. C&I.

## About

- [About W.I.S.E.C.E.O.](https://www.wiseceo.org/about.html): Mission, vision, who we serve, wrap-around supports, where we serve, partners
- [Our Founder, Tiffany Davidson](https://www.wiseceo.org/tiffanydavidson.html): Educator, literacy advocate and language-acquisition specialist
- [Newsroom](https://www.wiseceo.org/about/newsroom/): Announcements and recognition
- [Contact](https://www.wiseceo.org/contact.html): Questions, volunteering, partnerships and language assistance

## Programs

- [Programs](https://www.wiseceo.org/programs.html): WISECEO Academy Career Fellowship (no-cost, grades 9–12: cybersecurity, energy and infrastructure, AI), Digital Literacy & Coding, Workforce Development, Entrepreneurship & Innovation, Youth Leadership Academy, Education Access & Equity, Community Economic Resilience
- [Literacy & Language Access](https://www.wiseceo.org/literacy.html): Family literacy, English learner (SIOP) support, IEP and 504 navigation, educator learning
- [Apply to a program](https://www.wiseceo.org/apply.html): Program intake form

## Articles and resources

- [Six SIOP Moves Every Teacher Can Use Tomorrow With English Learners](https://www.wiseceo.org/articles/siop-moves-for-teachers.html): Research-based strategies for teachers of English learners
- [Reading Is the First Job Skill](https://www.wiseceo.org/articles/reading-is-the-first-job-skill.html): Why literacy is workforce development, and how families can build it at home
- [Your Child's IEP, Explained](https://www.wiseceo.org/articles/iep-family-guide.html): A family guide to IEP meetings, rights and questions to ask
- [Taxing the Unbanked](https://www.wiseceo.org/articles/taxing-the-unbanked.html): Ohio check-cashing and payday borrower protections
- [News & Resources](https://www.wiseceo.org/newsletter.html): All articles and the newsletter
- [Listen: 2026 Election Issue](https://www.wiseceo.org/listen/2026-election.html): Audio edition in several languages
